research_status: COMPLETE — all 12 episodes of Seraph of the End's first cour classified canon. Confirmed by two agreeing sources (a general aggregate search and a direct fetch of QuoteTheAnime's page) that this cour is a faithful, complete manga adaptation with zero filler. The franchise's one genuinely mixed episode (episode 25, per QuoteTheAnime) belongs to the second cour ('Battle in Nagoya'), a separate AniList entry not covered by this project's catalog entry (AniList id 20829, confirmed 12 episodes). No episode titles included in the JSON — episode titles were visible in the source and match what AniList's own streaming-episode data will provide via load_episodes.py's auto-backfill (#103) once loaded, so hand-typing them here would be redundant. Complete, gap-free coverage of 1-12 confirmed before writing this file.
